newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Inventec limit-up on ex-rights date.
newsitem.headline: Inventec limit-up on ex-rights date.

text.p: Taiwan computer maker Inventec Corp soared limit-up in late trade on its ex-rights date on Friday, as investors showed their confidence about the firm's profit outlook, brokers said.
With 45 minutes left at 0315 GMT, Inventec was up the daily seven percent limit or T$11 to T$175.
Inventec, one of Taiwan's leading makers of monitors and an emerging contender in notebook computers, made a bonus issue of T$12 per share, or 1,200 shares for every 1,000 shares held.
"It is not surprising to see the company going limit-up on its ex-rights date due to its past sound performance," said George Hou, fund manager for Jardine Fleming.
Hou said the firm's shares likely would ride the ex-rights momentum for another session before experiencing profit-taking pressure.
Inventec posted a pre-tax profit of T$4.3 billion on sales of T$43.5 billion in 1996.
